claims.statement: The natural universal reading of the Izgin-Kopecz-Meister-Schilling conjecture (every MPRK scheme with a nonnegative underlying Runge-Kutta tableau is globally linearly stable, Definition 1 and Conjecture 2 of the paper) is false.

MPRK22(4/7) with step size 1 on y' = Ay, A = [[-9990, 10], [9990, -10]], started at (1/2, 1/2), converges to an attracting positive two-cycle (about (0.4935, 0.5065) and (1.08e-7, 0.99999989)); the steady state (1/1000, 999/1000) is the unique positive fixed point on the unit-mass simplex and is locally asymptotically stable with multiplier -349959993/400110007.

For the counterexample, F is strictly decreasing on (0,1) and F^2 - id has exactly five zeros; initial first components in the open interval (s_L, s_H), of length in [0.10804900399, 0.10804900400], converge to the steady state; those outside [s_L, s_H] converge to the attracting two-cycle; s_L and s_H form a repelling two-cycle.
For every alpha in (1/2, 1/phi), 1/phi = (sqrt(5)-1)/2, MPRK22(alpha) has two-cycles for sufficiently asymmetric two-species equilibria and sufficiently large steps.

For every alpha in [53/100, 56/100], p in [1e-4, 1e-3] and K in [1e4, 1e6], the two-species map F_{K,p} of MPRK22(alpha) has a positive two-cycle; hence MPRK22(alpha) does not converge to the steady state from every positive initial value for these parameters.

(a) For each alpha in {13/25, 11/20, 4/7} and p in {1e-3, 1e-4, 1e-5}, F_{K,p} has an attracting positive two-cycle for every K >= 1e4, as does the limit map; (b) every (alpha, p, K) with alpha in (4/7)[1-1e-4, 1+1e-4], p in 1e-3[1-1e-3, 1+1e-3], K in 1e4[1-1e-3, 1+1e-3] has an attracting positive two-cycle.
MPRK22(4/7) has an attracting two-cycle for the reversible chain A <-> B <-> C stated in Theorem 12.

MPRK43II(37/50), all of whose nonzero tableau coefficients are positive (a21 = 2/3, a31 = 73/222, a32 = 25/74, b = (1/4, 1/100, 37/50)), applied with step 1 to the two-species system with K = 1e7, p = 1e-4: the steady state is a locally asymptotically stable fixed point (F'(p) about -0.6250), yet every initial value with first component in H = [0.4935, 0.5035], including (1/2, 1/2), converges to an attracting two-cycle. Uniqueness of its positive fixed point is not claimed.
For 1/2 <= alpha <= 1, MPRK22(alpha) has no spurious positive fixed points on irreducible positive conservative linear systems in any dimension.
MPRK22(1/2) converges to the steady state on every two-species positive conservative linear system, for every step size and positive initial value.
MPRK22(1) converges to the steady state on every two-species positive conservative linear system, for every step size and positive initial value.

Refined conjecture (open): (a) for alpha > 0, two-species global linear stability of MPRK22(alpha) holds if and only if alpha = 1/2 or alpha >= 1/phi; (b) MPRK22(1) is globally linearly stable in all dimensions.
